ADFActivityRun.operations_status: not enumerated in Azure docs (checked https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/data-factory/monitor-data-factory-reference); columns below are the verified allowlist
ADFActivityRun.operations_note: Read the service's own monitoring data reference (Activity-run log attributes section). operationName is a TEMPLATE, not a fixed list: doc says 'The name of the activity with its status. If the activity is the start heartbeat, the property value is `MyActivity -`. If the activity is the end heartbeat, the property value is `MyActivity - Succeeded`.' Pattern is '<activityName> - <status>'. Also checked monitor-data-factory (how-to page) which links only to this reference. No fixed values enumerable.
